description.value: SunTea Canada is a fresh-brewed bubble tea chain founded in 2019, offering fruit teas and milk teas with online ordering and a rewards app. The Kingsway Burnaby location is one of several Metro Vancouver outlets, situated in a unit-style retail space with indoor seating. Cyclists passing through the area can order ahead for quick pickup via the chain's Toast-integrated online platform.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: rack (2 spaces) at 26m. Total: 2 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is SunTea's Kingsway Burnaby location (#150-5172 Kingsway), listed as 'Open' on the /orders store page, corroborating the OSM address and website URL. The site is a bubble tea chain focused on pickup/online ordering; no cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi) are mentioned anywhere in the website content or OSM tags. Takeout is clearly the primary service model based on the prominent 'Order Pickup' functionality and the absence of any dine-in emphasis.
concerns: No phone number in OSM or on the website; contact is email-only (info@sunteabc.com).
Chain-owned unit in a retail complex — cyclist amenities (bike parking, washrooms) depend on the shopping center, not the business itself, and could not be verified.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: SunTea is a legitimate, open bubble tea cafe on a cycling-accessible corridor, but none of the three required WWC criteria (bike parking/visibility, water refill, washrooms) are confirmed from any evidence source. A site visit or direct contact would be needed to establish minimum qualification.
enrichment_extras.notes: The OSM check_date is 2022-11-01; the website's /orders page confirms the Kingsway Burnaby location is still active as of 2026. OSM opening hours (Mo-Th,Su 12:00-22:00; Fr-Sa 12:00-23:00) differ from the website listing (11 AM – 11 PM daily) — website hours are likely more current.
